description.value: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.
This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

Activate A Interact

After you drink this mutagen, your body becomes thick and sturdy. You exhibit a healthy glow, though you tend to be ponderous and unobservant.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saves and 10 temporary Hit Points. Whenever you are at maximum Hit Points for at least 1 full minute, you regain the temporary Hit Points.

Drawback You take a -2 penalty to Will saves, Perception checks and initiative rolls.

Duration 10 minute.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.fUrZ4xcMJz0CfTyG]{Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate)}

Activate F Envision

Trigger You successfully Trip a foe

Requirements You are trained in Athletics

This wolf canine is bound in a strip of leather and tied to a buckle or strap of a suit of armor.

When you activate the fang, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier to the target of your Trip. If your Trip would already deal physical damage that doesn't include an ability modifier, add your Strength modifier to that damage.

Activate A Interact

When you apply this thick, viscous oil to a non-magical weapon or suit of armor, that item immediately becomes magically potent. If the item is a weapon, it temporarily becomes a +1 striking weapon, or, if it's armor, it temporarily becomes +1 resilient armor. This lasts for 1 minute.
Longswords can be one‑edged or two‑edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

(acid) Koruvus spews a 20 foot line of foul-smelling and acidic blood from his mouth that deals 4d6 acid damage (DC 17 Reflex save). Koruvus can't use Vomit Bile again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage

Success The creature takes half damage and is sickened for one turn as they shke off the remaining bile

Failure The creature takes full damage and is sickened for 1 minute

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is sickened 2 for 10 minutes. The creature can't reduce its sickened condition below 1 until the 10 minutes has elapsed.

Prerequisites At least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat

Frequency Once per day

Trigger You are attacked by a foe

The magic within you manifests as a natural reaction to threats. You gain the effects of @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image} but with two images instead of three. The tradition of this action matches the tradition of your gnome ancestry options.
